hypothesis_source: v1: first 20-session high after a 20-bar rest was worse than same-day watch names without the breakout (10/20-day date-EW spread -0.58%/-0.90%). Mechanism: rest-then-pop is a chase. Replacement: any signal-day close above the prior 20 valid-bar high, no cooldown. That is 'currently leaving the month range', not 'first pop after sitting'. Same 20-session lookback, not a window scan.
distinct_from_failed_representations: Not a 19/21-day scan. Not VCP. Not all-market trend_breakout. Difference from v1: drop the 20-bar cooldown so consecutive expansion days can trigger. Difference from sequence-2 buy-all: still only trade the trigger subset.
exposure: Training 2016-01-01 through 2022-12-31. Labels must not cross 2022-12-31.

trigger.definition: Causal close > prior 20 valid-bar high (high shifted by 1 valid bar). No cooldown. Reuse valid_rolling_max + valid_shift.

selected: Watch list AND close above prior 20-session high.
control: Same-day watch-list names without that close-above-high.

pass_fail.pass: 10-day and 20-day date-EW net of the trigger subset is not worse than same-day watch names without the trigger.
pass_fail.fail: This is the one allowed rewrite of the breakout event. If still worse than same-day untriggered leaders, stop this 20-session-high family; next gun on layer 3 must be a different breakout event (not VCP, not a 20-day scan). Do not skip to pullback as the selector.
